newsitem.title: ITALY: TIM has 6.4 million mobile phone clients.
newsitem.headline: TIM has 6.4 million mobile phone clients.

text.p: Italy's mobile phone group Telecom Italia Mobile (TIM) said on Thursday that it had some 6.4 million clients for its mobile phone network.

It added in a statement released at the group's annual general meeting in Turin that as of today the group had 1.45 million GSM digital mobile phone subscribers, 1.2 million GSM TIM card subscribers and 3.7 million clients for its analogue service.
TIM said that in only six months since its launch, its GSM TIM card had gained 1.45 million clients.
During 1996, the group saw a 47.5 percent rise in clients to 5.7 million at end-1996 from 3.8 million at end-1995.
The group's managing director, Vito Gamberale, told the annual meeting that in the first three months of 1997, the group had proceeded "perfectly in line with its budget".
TIM reported a 1996 net profit of 930 billion lire ($544.6 million) and had a 1996 dividend of 50 lire per ordinary share.
